content: Toahiya xowaka Enore irae wahetakomaniyereharenae hiye iraiti xakaisaseharenae kanasakota kahaliki, exahe kahare maniyata.

Kalikini wisaonitere miyanitiye xowakehena atyo hoka Enore irae wikakoa Haisani kanasakota. Ihiyeta atyo Enore tyotya xoalini harenae tyoma. Enore xaokalita atyo tyotya xoalini hare enomanere makere tyaona.

Ityani Hanexe niyatere kakoa kinatere aokanaita Hanexe akereta, exahe hoka waiye hakakoa Hanexe kakoa. Hairaene kinaterexe kakoa tyotya xoalini hare aiyatelikijita. Hoka halitinae nómane iniyalahare emaisahetehenere najikinita enokoa nali tyoka, Enore kinaterexe fihini maniya.
Enore Ityani atyo anjonae xahehare tyaona. Hiyeta hoka Enore anjonae xahehare aokene.
Hiyaiya, maisa atyo Enore hatyanae anjo hiye xoana xowaka nita:

content.text: Nityani atyo hiso, kalikini atyo Hexe notyaona.

content: Exahe maisa tehitiya atyo hatyanae anjo hiye nita:

content.text: Hexe ite notyaona, hiso atyo ite Nityani.

content: Nexa tehitiya irae axikahenere Haisani hetatiye halitinae koni xowaka:

content.text: Maika ite Enore wakanehare anjonae tyotya awaiyetya Nityani, haxahehare aokahene.
Enore hoholati akereta moka anjonae, hawakaneharenae irikati biyaloitere akereta moka.

content: Hoka exakere atyo Haisani tahi irae:

content.text: Xekohaseti ite hisaota mene, Enore. Waiye taita ite hamoka hikaxaikone hotyali.
Xoalini hare waiyexe taita hawaiyetita hoka iniyalahare atyo maisa hawaiyetyare. Hiyeta hoka hEnorexa haomana aoka hiso hoka hikaxaihalahalinikisaka, hikaxaiminisaka xoaha hihinaeharenae xahe.
Hetati xowakiya maisa xoare aka hoka hiso atyo hisoma waikohe, enokoa harenae, Xekohaseti, hoka hikahe kakoa hisoma.
Maiyarehetaha ite, imiti exololohare akereta kiraharehetaha ite. Hoka Hiso atyo ite hisaoneta mene.
Hityahahenahitene ite imiti kaxityahatyakihititere akere hoka ewenekoareha atyo ite waitare tyaohitiya. Hoka heko atyo ite hisaona, maisaiya atyo hohiyeta.

content: Enore maisa xoana xowaka nexare hatyanae anjo hiye:

content.text: Hisokehena nofihini maniya hahalákoaharenae hikiji katyahe namohenere kijiya.

content: Hoka xoare hare atyo anjonae? Isekohalitinae atyo, Enore ana hakahitaha. Enore atyo axikatyahene halitinae iniyalahare nonitata kaiyakehetehenerenae kahinaetya maheta.
